# Nosferato

NOT-SAFE-FOR-APP-STORES Pi rig. The NSFAS sibling of NearTrace.

## Status

Landing site not yet live. Source is at [github.com/code-hartle-tech/nosferatos](https://github.com/code-hartle-tech/nosferatos). The project board is HARTLE.TECH project #2.

## What it is

Where NearTrace stays inside the Google Play policy envelope, Nosferato is the lane for everything that doesn't — the Pi Zero 2 W rig, the Alfa adapter mount, the off-store distribution path. Companion piece, separate cadence.
